body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> LG Electronics presented its chocolate phone ''VX-8500'' during CES 2007. It supports Verizon''s CDMA2000 1x EV-DO service ''V-CAST''. It features Bluetooth connectivity, external T-Flash slot, and 1.3M camera. It is available in four colors – mint, cherry, white, and black.
